newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Airlines Inc Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Airlines Inc Q3 loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
Q3 1995 results include $57.5 million charge for shares distributed to employees, $242.2 million reorganization charges and $140.9 million gain for debt retirement.
Excluding items, Q3 1995 operating income would have been $103.3 million and net income would have been $76.8 million.
Q3 1996 net loss before $3,869,000 in preferred stock dividends vs $4,981,000.
No per share figure given for Q3 1995. Net loss $0.16 a share for reorganized TWA for one month ended September 30, 1995.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
Nine-month 1995 results after charges and gains outlined in Q3.
Nine-month 1996 net loss before $32,681,000 in preferred stock dividends vs $12,717,000 a year ago.
